name: Breaking News English
description_short: Current-events reading and listening lessons published twice a week at 7 difficulty levels, each with comprehension quizzes, audio at varying speeds, and downloadable handouts.
teacher_note: Handy when a student wants to talk about something topical — pick the level, skim the text together, then use the built-in discussion questions.
creator: Breaking News English
internal_notes: Verified live: free, no login, 3600+ lessons confirmed. cefr_level left unknown rather than guessed — site uses its own 7-tier Level 0-6 system, not CEFR bands, so mapping would be an inference. group_fit/teaching_use minimal for the same broad-hub reason as iSLCollective/ELLLO.
